evolve-hq.title: Route an Evolve HQ job
evolve-hq.description: Find the relevant workstream and its next step.
evolve-hq.inputs: A product and the outcome you want.
evolve-hq.output: A desk assignment and plan for the work.

evolve-skill.title: Run the full ecommerce workflow
evolve-skill.description: Move from product intake to research, creative production, and test review.
evolve-skill.inputs: Product materials and any completed steps.
evolve-skill.output: An ecommerce deliverable and the next checkpoint.

evolve-intake.title: Set up a product brief
evolve-intake.description: Clarify what you sell, who buys it, and what you need to decide.
evolve-intake.inputs: A product link, draft brief, or description.
evolve-intake.output: A product brief and research questions.

evolve-roadmap.title: Plan your creative roadmap
evolve-roadmap.description: Organize controls, variations, and future ad batches.
evolve-roadmap.inputs: Existing ads, test notes, and upcoming priorities.
evolve-roadmap.output: A list of batches, assets, and next tests.

launch.title: Plan a launch
launch.description: Prepare how a product or feature reaches its first audience.
launch.inputs: What is launching, who it is for, and a target date.
launch.output: A launch timeline and channel plan.

market-research-team.title: Run a research sprint
market-research-team.description: Review customer and competitor evidence before proposing ad angles.
market-research-team.inputs: Product, target market, and the decision to make.
market-research-team.output: A source-linked brief and up to three ad angles.

market-research.title: Research a product and market
market-research.description: Research a product, what buyers already know, and what may be holding them back.
market-research.inputs: Product brief or URL, market, and available sources.
market-research.output: A reviewed research brief and source list.

evolve-research.title: Run Evolve research
evolve-research.description: Build an evidence base for a product or a focused question.
evolve-research.inputs: Product details and the research question.
evolve-research.output: A research dossier or focused findings.

evolve-customer-market.title: Find customer buying patterns
evolve-customer-market.description: Collect triggers, objections, alternatives, and customer language.
evolve-customer-market.inputs: Product, target market, and any reviews or interviews.

evolve-account-research.title: Review your own ad account
evolve-account-research.description: Identify the strongest and weakest patterns in your current creative.
evolve-account-research.inputs: Ad export, creative samples, and reporting period.
evolve-account-research.output: A creative baseline for the next test.

evolve-competitor-creative.title: Study competitor ads
evolve-competitor-creative.description: Identify what competing ads emphasize across hooks, offers, and formats.
evolve-competitor-creative.inputs: Competitor names, ad links, or supplied examples.

evolve-insights.title: Organize customer insights
evolve-insights.description: Turn buyer comments into a clear explanation of who hesitates, why, and what to check next.
evolve-insights.inputs: Research notes or a source-indexed evidence file.
evolve-insights.output: Buyer profiles, beliefs, and ad opportunities.

customer-research.title: Understand your customers
customer-research.description: Plan research or synthesize customer interviews, surveys, and feedback.
customer-research.inputs: Research question and any existing responses.
customer-research.output: A research plan or themes backed by feedback.

competitor-profiling.title: Profile competing offers
competitor-profiling.description: Capture competing products, pricing, terms, and positioning.
competitor-profiling.inputs: Product, target market, and competitor names or links.

competitors.title: Improve comparison pages
competitors.description: Evaluate competing alternatives and the pages that present them.
competitors.inputs: Your product and the competing alternative or page.
competitors.output: A comparison outline, gap analysis, or draft.

manual-voc-research.title: Analyze supplied customer quotes
manual-voc-research.description: Find patterns in reviews, comments, and customer quotes you provide.
manual-voc-research.inputs: Pasted reviews, customer quotes, or discussion excerpts.
manual-voc-research.output: Themes and opportunities linked to the source quotes.

anthony-camacho-research.title: Map buyer desires and solution beliefs
anthony-camacho-research.description: Find the desires and solution beliefs behind purchase decisions.
anthony-camacho-research.inputs: Product, market, and customer research sources.
anthony-camacho-research.output: A structured buyer motivation brief and next test.

last30days.title: Find recent public discussion
last30days.description: See what people have been saying about a product or topic lately.
last30days.inputs: A topic, brand, or product category.
last30days.output: A dated summary with public source links.

evolve-angles.title: Find ad angles to test
evolve-angles.description: Turn customer insights into distinct creative hypotheses.
evolve-angles.inputs: Product facts and research or customer evidence.
evolve-angles.output: Angles with audiences, reasoning, and test ideas.

evolve-positioning.title: Define your positioning
evolve-positioning.description: Choose the buyer belief and difference your brand should communicate.
evolve-positioning.output: A positioning statement and message hierarchy.

evolve-briefs.title: Write a creative brief
evolve-briefs.description: Build an Evolve brief for an original ad, a reference, or a variation.
evolve-briefs.inputs: Approved angle and any source ad, offer, and constraints.
evolve-briefs.output: A brief in the appropriate Evolve format.

evolve-copywriting.title: Write Evolve ad copy
evolve-copywriting.description: Turn an approved brief into copy for a specific ad format.
evolve-copywriting.inputs: Approved creative brief, product facts, and voice.
evolve-copywriting.output: Ad copy with hooks and a call to action.

evolve-copy-review.title: Fix weak ad copy
evolve-copy-review.description: Diagnose where an existing draft breaks down and rewrite it.
evolve-copy-review.inputs: The draft, target audience, and desired action.

evolve-storytelling.title: Build a story for an ad
evolve-storytelling.description: Turn evidence into a shootable narrative with meaningful beats.
evolve-storytelling.inputs: Angle, product, credible proof, and desired duration.
evolve-storytelling.output: A story outline and shootable script.

copywriting.title: Rewrite marketing copy
copywriting.description: Improve the message on a homepage, landing page, or campaign.
copywriting.inputs: Existing copy, buyer, offer, and the next action.
copywriting.output: Revised copy with key changes explained.

cold-traffic-ad-craft.title: Write for a cold audience
cold-traffic-ad-craft.description: Develop or review indirect native ad copy for first-time buyers.
cold-traffic-ad-craft.inputs: Offer, audience, product facts, and any draft.
cold-traffic-ad-craft.output: A cold-audience copy direction or revision.

native-ads-research-to-creative.title: Build a long-form native ad
native-ads-research-to-creative.description: Write or review a story ad for Facebook or Instagram, or plan photos for an ad you already have.
native-ads-research-to-creative.inputs: Product research, buyer and offer for a new ad, or the exact ad text for photo planning.
native-ads-research-to-creative.output: A written ad with review notes or, for image-only jobs, photo directions and image prompts.

write-video-ad-scripts.title: Write a video ad script
write-video-ad-scripts.description: Create a practical script with spoken lines, shots, and pacing.
write-video-ad-scripts.inputs: Product, audience, angle, length, and available footage.
write-video-ad-scripts.output: A production-ready script and shot cues.

humanizer.title: Make copy sound more natural
humanizer.description: Revise stiff or generic phrasing while preserving the message.
humanizer.inputs: Draft copy and an example of your voice, if available.
humanizer.output: A cleaner version in the intended voice.

offers.title: Improve your offer
offers.description: Clarify what buyers get and which terms make it compelling.
offers.inputs: Current offer, price, audience, economics, and constraints.
offers.output: Recommended offer changes and test ideas.

pricing.title: Review pricing and bundles
pricing.description: Evaluate price points, packs, and how to present them.
pricing.inputs: Product, current prices, costs, and competitor context.
pricing.output: Pricing or bundling options with tradeoffs.

evolve-create.title: Develop an ad concept
evolve-create.description: Take a new angle, reference ad, or existing ad into production planning.
evolve-create.inputs: A brief or reference, product facts, and constraints.
evolve-create.output: A concept or variation with a creative handoff.

evolve-iteration.title: Make an ad variation
evolve-iteration.description: Apply Evolve’s iteration process to a specific parent ad.
evolve-iteration.inputs: Parent ad, results, and the element to change.
evolve-iteration.output: An iteration brief with a testable change.

evolve-ugc.title: Plan creator content
evolve-ugc.description: Develop a creator sourcing, production, and feedback plan.
evolve-ugc.inputs: Product, target buyer, budget constraints, and content needs.
evolve-ugc.output: Creator criteria and a content collection plan.

evolve-partnership-ads.title: Plan partnership ads
evolve-partnership-ads.description: Prepare a test using creator or partner ads.
evolve-partnership-ads.inputs: Creator or partner context, assets, and campaign goal.
evolve-partnership-ads.output: A partnership brief and test plan.

adapt-reference-ad.title: Adapt a reference ad
adapt-reference-ad.description: Match the source message, type and layout to your product and test.
adapt-reference-ad.inputs: Reference image, product, verified claims, and target format.
adapt-reference-ad.output: A complete replacement map and instructions for a local or connected-editor build.

build-static-ads-in-figma.title: Plan or build static ads
build-static-ads-in-figma.description: Review every available template for a test, or turn a customer insight into a layout.
build-static-ads-in-figma.inputs: For browsing, a library link or authorized source. For planning, a brief, product assets, dimensions, and brand guidance.
build-static-ads-in-figma.output: A template decision and production brief. The skill can also export PNG and editable SVG in a local terminal session.

metaphor-ads.title: Find visual metaphors for an ad
metaphor-ads.description: Propose and rank visual ways to show a benefit or objection.
metaphor-ads.inputs: Customer insight, product, and visual constraints.
metaphor-ads.output: Ranked concepts with clear visual directions.

evolve-production.title: Prepare creative for production
evolve-production.description: Convert a brief into a practical editing or design handoff.
evolve-production.inputs: Approved brief, format, available assets, and constraints.
evolve-production.output: A production plan, shot list, or editing handoff.

evolve-media-buying.title: Review paid campaign decisions
evolve-media-buying.description: Evaluate the evidence for keeping, changing, or scaling campaigns.
evolve-media-buying.inputs: Campaign export, attribution window, and economics.
evolve-media-buying.output: A recommendation with risks and next checks.

evolve-creative-analysis.title: Review ad performance
evolve-creative-analysis.description: Analyze one ad or run a batch-level creative review.
evolve-creative-analysis.inputs: Ad files, results, and the decision you need to make.
evolve-creative-analysis.output: Findings and the next creative tests.

evolve-test-design.title: Design a marketing test
evolve-test-design.description: Define a clean comparison for a campaign or page change.
evolve-test-design.inputs: Hypothesis, current version, candidate variant, and metrics.
evolve-test-design.output: A test setup with success and guardrail metrics.

analyze-ads.title: Critique an ad or script
analyze-ads.description: Find specific issues in the hook, message, visuals, or call to action.
analyze-ads.inputs: Ad image, script, or exported frames and audience.
analyze-ads.output: A prioritized critique and revised creative suggestions.

ads.title: Plan or troubleshoot paid ads
ads.description: Review the structure, targeting, and creative of a campaign.
ads.inputs: Platform, goal, campaign setup, and any performance data.
ads.output: A campaign plan or diagnostic checklist.

analytics.title: Audit tracking and analytics
analytics.description: Check if your events and reporting answer the decision at hand.
analytics.inputs: Event map, reporting examples, and key actions.
analytics.output: A tracking checklist and recommended fixes.

attribution.title: Understand where sales came from
attribution.description: Compare what different measurement methods imply about revenue.
attribution.inputs: Channel results, windows, and how attribution is defined.
attribution.output: A measurement comparison and gaps to resolve.

ab-testing.title: Plan or read an A/B test
ab-testing.description: Set up an experiment or interpret a test you already ran.
ab-testing.inputs: Variants, traffic, conversions, and expected change, if known.
ab-testing.output: A test plan or interpretation with limitations.

store-content-cro-review.title: Review store copy and images
store-content-cro-review.description: Find what may stop shoppers from buying and what to change on the page.
store-content-cro-review.inputs: A public store URL or screenshots. Add gallery images or metrics if you have them.
store-content-cro-review.output: Prioritized fixes, replacement copy, an image shot list, and a first test.

build-advertorials.title: Draft an advertorial
build-advertorials.description: Write a long-form page that follows through on an ad’s promise.
build-advertorials.inputs: Ad angle, offer, buyer, and substantiated proof.
build-advertorials.output: A structured advertorial draft and proof gaps.

write-product-page-copy.title: Write a product page
write-product-page-copy.description: Improve product sections, benefits, and answers to buyer objections.
write-product-page-copy.inputs: Product facts, target buyer, offer, and any current copy.

cro.title: Improve page conversions
cro.description: Diagnose buying friction and prioritize changes for a page or funnel.
cro.inputs: A page URL, screenshots, analytics, or funnel context.
cro.output: Prioritized conversion ideas and hypotheses to test.

emails.title: Write an email sequence
emails.description: Draft emails for a specific stage of the customer journey.
emails.inputs: Audience, offer, trigger, and email goal.
emails.output: An email sequence with timing and copy.

max-ecommerce-email.title: Improve ecommerce email and SMS
max-ecommerce-email.description: Audit or develop ecommerce flows across email and SMS.
max-ecommerce-email.inputs: Current messages, triggers, results, and audience.
max-ecommerce-email.output: A flow audit or drafts with timing and priorities.

churn-prevention.title: Reduce customer cancellations
churn-prevention.description: Find likely reasons for cancellation and plan retention fixes.
churn-prevention.inputs: Cancellation reasons, product terms, and customer segments.

post-purchase-funnels.title: Plan post-purchase offers
post-purchase-funnels.description: Design a useful upsell or experience after checkout.
post-purchase-funnels.inputs: Products, margins, typical order, and current funnel.
post-purchase-funnels.output: A post-purchase plan, copy, and tests.

ai-seo.title: Improve visibility in AI answers
ai-seo.description: Find content and evidence gaps that limit discoverability.
ai-seo.inputs: Brand, topic, target questions, and existing pages.
ai-seo.output: Content improvements and a visibility checklist.

aso.title: Improve your app listing
aso.description: Review how an App Store or Google Play listing converts.
aso.inputs: App listing URL or screenshots, category, and target buyer.
aso.output: Listing copy, image direction, and testing ideas.

co-marketing.title: Plan a joint campaign
co-marketing.description: Find partner fit and structure a shared marketing idea.
co-marketing.inputs: Your audience, offer, partner options, and objective.
co-marketing.output: A partner shortlist or a joint campaign plan.

community-marketing.title: Grow a community
community-marketing.description: Plan how to attract and support a community around the product.
community-marketing.inputs: Audience, existing community, goals, and available time.
community-marketing.output: A community plan and practical operating cadence.

content-strategy.title: Plan useful content
content-strategy.description: Choose topics and formats based on what your audience needs.
content-strategy.inputs: Audience, goal, channels, and existing content.
content-strategy.output: Content themes, priorities, and an editorial plan.

vibe-coding-toolkit.title: Plan a technical improvement
vibe-coding-toolkit.description: Turn an app or workflow request into implementation and verification steps.
vibe-coding-toolkit.inputs: The feature, problem, or codebase context.
vibe-coding-toolkit.output: A technical plan and concrete acceptance checks.

free-ecommerce-workflows.title: Plan a free local workflow
free-ecommerce-workflows.description: Choose the right local draft, report, or production tool for the job.
free-ecommerce-workflows.inputs: The intended output and supplied inputs.
free-ecommerce-workflows.output: An action recommendation and input template. Run files in Local tools.
